scripts.dev: ./ensure-db.sh && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: ./ensure-db.sh && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d mysql || sudo systemctl start mariadb
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
